alertPacks.title: Alert Packs
alertPacks.intro: Start with a goal, not a blank rule. Preview a curated group, choose your vehicles and install ordinary, independently editable rules.
alertPacks.trySearch: Try another search or clear the filter.
alertPacks.choosePack: Preview a pack above to get started. Existing rules and templates are unchanged.
alertPacks.once: Fires once when the condition becomes true; resets when it becomes false. Changed-value rules fire on each change, subject to cooldown.
alertPacks.canonicalTemperature: Enter Celsius; the trigger summary above also shows your preferred temperature unit.
alertPacks.placeholders: Keep the double-braced placeholder names unchanged.
alertPacks.unsaved: You have an uninstalled alert pack configuration.
alertPacks.installed: Pack installed. Created {{created}} rules; reused {{reused}} existing rules without changing them.
alertPacks.delivery: Uses your existing notification channels, preferences and quiet hours. No vehicle commands are sent. Telemetry availability varies by vehicle.
alertPacks.duplicates: Matching triggers for the same vehicle selection are reused unchanged, even if disabled. Different thresholds or overlapping vehicle selections may still produce similar notifications.
alertPacks.disabledDefault: New rules are disabled by default so you can review them. Existing rules keep their current enabled state.
alertPacks.invalid: Select at least one rule and a vehicle scope, and check message, threshold and cooldown values.
alertPacks.discard: Discard this pack configuration? No rules have been installed.
alertPacks.editIndividually: Rules remain independent. Edit, enable, disable or delete them in the existing rule editor. Pack updates never overwrite your changes.
alertPacks.removeHelp: By default, all rules are kept. Select only the rules you also want to delete, including any edits you made to them. Existing or shared rules cannot be deleted here.
alertPacks.ruleMissing: This rule is no longer available. Refresh the rule list.
alertPacks.aiTitle: Build a custom pack with Helix
alertPacks.aiDescription: Describe your goal. Helix selects a small group from supported rules; you review the configuration and explicitly install it.
alertPacks.goal: What would you like to keep an eye on?
alertPacks.goalExample: For example: a low-noise group for charging and battery on longer trips

everyday.name: Everyday essentials
everyday.description: A low-noise starting set for battery, charging and software changes.

charging.name: Charging companion
charging.description: Follow charging state changes without assuming why a session stopped.

security.name: Security settings
security.description: Stay aware of lock and access-setting changes. These are not intrusion detection or parked-only rules.

trip.name: Road-trip companion
trip.description: Battery and charging reminders for longer journeys; no navigation or vehicle commands.

climate.name: Cabin comfort
climate.description: Temperature reminders, not a safety monitor. Vehicle telemetry may be delayed or unavailable.

battery.name: Battery watch
battery.description: Battery thresholds and charge-limit changes with once-per-condition notifications.

custom.name: Custom pack
custom.description: Choose supported rules to build your own group.

battery-low.name: Battery running low
battery-low.message: {{VehicleName}} is down to {{Value}}% battery. Time to put the next charge on the map.

battery-critical.name: Battery critically low
battery-critical.message: {{VehicleName}} has {{Value}}% battery remaining. Plan a safe charging stop.

charge-complete.name: Charging complete
charge-complete.message: {{VehicleName}} has finished its charging chapter. Next stop: your choice.

charge-started.name: Charging started
charge-started.message: {{VehicleName}} is taking an electricity break. Charging has started.

charge-stopped.name: Charging stopped
charge-stopped.message: {{VehicleName}} reports charging stopped. If that was not planned, check the session.

unlocked.name: Vehicle unlocked
unlocked.message: {{VehicleName}} reports unlocked. A useful heads-up if you expected it to be locked.

pin-disabled.name: PIN to Drive disabled
pin-disabled.message: {{VehicleName}} reports PIN to Drive disabled. Check this setting if the change was unexpected.

valet-enabled.name: Valet mode enabled
valet-enabled.message: {{VehicleName}} reports Valet Mode enabled. The keys may be shared, but the settings are worth a glance.

cabin-hot.name: Cabin temperature high
cabin-hot.message: {{VehicleName}} reports a hot cabin. Check cabin conditions before getting in; never rely on this alert for occupant safety.

cabin-cold.name: Cabin below freezing
cabin-cold.message: {{VehicleName}} has a frosty cabin. Consider preconditioning before your next departure.

software-version.name: Software version changed
software-version.message: {{VehicleName}} has a new software chapter: {{Value}}. Take a look at the release notes.

preconditioning.name: Preconditioning active
preconditioning.message: {{VehicleName}} is getting ready: preconditioning is active.

charge-limit.name: Charge limit changed
charge-limit.message: {{VehicleName}} has a new charging target: {{Value}}%. Check that it suits your next journey.
